settings.question: How much does a seasonal tire changeover cost in Calgary?
settings.answer: A changeover at Prince Tires is a flat rate by vehicle: $60 for most cars, SUVs, vans and EVs, $80 for trucks and larger trucks, $90 for dual-rear-wheel (dually) trucks, and $120 for trailers. That covers the swap itself — your tires already mounted on their own rims, moved onto your vehicle and torqued to spec. You'll see the exact price when you book online.

settings.question: When should I switch to winter tires in Calgary?
settings.answer: Most Calgary drivers swap to winter tires in late October, before the first real snowfall. Once daytime temperatures sit consistently below about 7°C, winter rubber grips better even on dry pavement. Don't wait for the first big dump on Deerfoot — the changeover rush builds fast through late October and November, and booking ahead means you pick the time instead of waiting in line.

settings.question: What's the difference between a changeover and tire installation?
settings.answer: A changeover assumes your winter and summer tires each sit on their own set of rims — we just swap which set is on the vehicle. Tire installation is for loose tires that aren't on rims yet: we mount them, balance them, and set up the wheels from scratch. If you're not sure which one you need, give us a call and describe what you've got.

settings.question: How long does a seasonal tire swap take?
settings.answer: A standard car or SUV changeover takes about 30 minutes. Trucks and duallies take a little longer. Book a time slot online and there's no waiting around — drop the vehicle, we swap the wheels, torque everything to spec, and you're back on the road.

settings.question: Do you store my off-season tires?
settings.answer: No — Prince Tires doesn't offer tire storage, so your off-season set goes home with you. Store them somewhere cool, dry and out of direct sunlight — a garage corner or basement works well. If they're on rims, stack them flat or hang them; loose tires are best kept standing upright.

settings.question: Can you swap tires I bought somewhere else?
settings.answer: Yes. It doesn't matter where your tires or rims came from — another shop, a dealership, online, or a used set. As long as your seasonal tires are mounted on rims that fit your vehicle, we'll change them over at the same flat rate, with no outside-purchase surcharge.

settings.heading: Seasonal Tire Changeover Calgary
settings.subheading: Swapping your winter tires on or off? Prince Tires changes over your seasonal tire-and-rim sets in about 30 minutes — every wheel torqued to spec — same-day at our SW Calgary shop.
settings.pricing_intro: A seasonal changeover is the straightforward swap: your winter and summer tires each live on their own set of rims, and we move the correct set onto your vehicle and torque every wheel to spec. It's a flat rate by vehicle — $60 for most cars, SUVs, vans and EVs, $80 for trucks, and $90 for dual-rear-wheel trucks. Your tires do need to be mounted on rims already; if they're loose, book a tire installation instead.
